messages.subject: Deducer installing problems
parts:
Hi there,

I have a Mac 10.7.5.
I have Java version 7 update 51.

I have installed R.3.1.0-snowleopard from the CRAN and followed the instructions (several times) on www.deducer.org

I have installed deducer: install.packages(c("JGR","Deducer", "DeducerExtras"))

When running on the R console the lines:
Sys.setenv(NOAWT=1)
library(JGR)
Sys.unsetenv("NOAWT")
JGR()

Deducer opens (not the data viewer though) but never stops and at some point we are asked to close it. 

The error message on the R console is:

Apr 14 18:50:31 dn51s4gu.sunet java[23768] <Error>: CGContextGetCTM: invalid context 0x0
Apr 14 18:50:31 dn51s4gu.sunet java[23768] <Error>: CGContextSetBaseCTM: invalid context 0x0
Apr 14 18:50:31 dn51s4gu.sunet java[23768] <Error>: CGContextGetCTM: invalid context 0x0
Apr 14 18:50:31 dn51s4gu.sunet java[23768] <Error>: CGContextSetBaseCTM: invalid context 0x0
Invalid memory access of location 0x0 rip=0x10602d3d8

Can you help me?

Thx a lot,
Julia
